topography.instrument: LRO LOLA gridded DEM LDEM_1024_45S_30S_150_180 (29.6 m, NASA PDS)

radar.instrument: Texture statistics of the slope grid (terrain-roughness proxy, not radar)

mineral.instrument: Typical values for mare basalt (not measured here; shown for context, not scored)

thermal.instrument: LRO Diviner bolometric surface temperature, daily max and min of the 0.5° bin (global_cumul_avg_cyl_50s40s_002.tab, NASA PDS)

curve.instrument: Sine-based day-night model between the low and high
